subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this PR advance the per-agent database to schema v11 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics, and if so what supported retrieval contract must replace `streamLogPath`?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit acceptance for SQLite schema-version bumps, while the current branch also removes a documented result field without establishing the permanent replacement contract.

options.title: Approve v11 with compatibility repairs
options.body: Approve the schema direction only after the branch provides a supported ACP history handle, updates all legacy consumers, and proves fresh and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split the ACP migration
options.body: Defer the schema bump and ACP contract change to a dedicated PR while retaining the independently repairable shared-audit and memory-event migrations here.

recommendation.title: Approve v11 with compatibility repairs
recommendation.body: Approve the schema direction only after the branch provides a supported ACP history handle, updates all legacy consumers, and proves fresh and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged SQLite storage flip makes this person the strongest history-backed owner for the per-agent schema and migration boundary.
